body:
## Summary

With the GDI ambience rain layer active (added to `frontend/cgo/picker.go`), the picker window exhibits mild flicker on each 10 Hz repaint. Nelson can tolerate the current level but it should be smoothed out.

## Cause

`paintWindow` paints directly to the window DC in a single-buffered fashion each WM_PAINT:

1. `FillRect(client, baseBg)` — wipes the whole frame
2. For each filled rain cell: `FillRect(cellRect, dropColor)` — stamps drops
3. For each text run: optional bg `FillRect` (for highlights) + `ExtTextOut` in transparent mode

At 10 Hz, the visible window briefly shows intermediate states between steps 1–3 before all draws complete. That's the perceptible flicker.

## Fix

Double-buffer via a compatible DC + bitmap:

1. `CreateCompatibleDC(hdc)` + `CreateCompatibleBitmap(hdc, clientW, clientH)`
2. `SelectObject(memDC, bmp)`
3. Do all rain + text painting to `memDC` (no visible flicker because offscreen)
4. `BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, w, h, memDC, 0, 0, SRCCOPY)` — single atomic blit to window
5. Clean up

Alternative: paint only the dirty region (per invalidated rect) rather than the full client. Useful if rain updates are per-drop deltas instead of full-grid repaints. Current sim returns a full grid from `GridCopy()` so per-cell dirty tracking would need extra state.

## Files

- `frontend/cgo/picker.go` — `paintWindow` function (single biggest change)

## Context

Part of the ambience-in-picker feature (GDI rain layer). Flicker is tolerable — filing now so the follow-up is tracked; don't block the main feature landing on this.
title: picker flickers during ambience rain redraws — needs double-buffering
